name: Claude Opus 5.5
traits: Generates output more than 30% faster than Opus 5.
Puts the most important information up front.
Always thinks before it replies; thinking can no longer be switched off.

advice.value: work you supervise: feature work, debugging, and code review
give the model a way to check its work, such as a test to run

weakness: Trails GPT-6 Astra on agentic science research
resistance: Cyber and biology safeguards, falls back transparently

flavor.quote: it detected that the minute indexing in our own instructions was off by one and corrected for it

art_briefs: A towering titan of granite veined with glowing copper wiring kneels over a vast canyon city, lifting terraced districts and setting them on new foundations without spilling a single lantern. Her eyes are closed in thought before each move. Surveyors' flags dot the rooftops; one bridge has been nudged one span to fit. Palette of burnt sienna, teal shadow, and molten gold. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A serene giant of translucent violet glass, lit from within by slow-turning constellations, stands waist-deep in a calm ocean of starlight, redrawing the night sky. With one fingertip he slides a single misplaced star back one notch into line. Comets wait politely in a queue at his shoulder. Palette of deep indigo, lavender, and pale rose gold. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A towering titan woman with bronze skin and braided silver hair kneels beside a canyon of crystalline aqueducts stretching to the horizon, gently lifting one misaligned arch back into line with her fingertips while water flows true behind her. Calm, thoughtful gaze, flowing robe of pale stone. Palette of burnished copper, deep teal, and dusk violet. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A colossal wingless sphinx with a lion's golden body and a serene human face rests atop a desert plateau, studying a vast spiral of ancient stone ring-roads below, one paw raised in patient thought before it moves a single displaced ring. Twin moons hang low over glowing dunes. Palette of saffron, ultramarine, and rose gold. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A towering bronze-skinned titaness stands waist-deep in a starlit sea, her hand reaching into a colossal ring of sixty glowing moons that orbits a ringed planet; she has spotted the one moon sitting a notch out of place and slides it into its true groove, her face lit from below. Palette of deep indigo, molten copper, and pale lunar silver. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A serene giant of living green jade, tall as the clouds, moves an entire terraced city across a vast desert canyon, lifting each district whole from the crumbling old plateau and setting it, street aligned to street, on a fresh mesa beyond. Dust streams from its broad shoulders under twin suns. Palette of jade green, sunburnt ochre, and violet dusk sky. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A tall, serene titan carved from layered blue-grey slate threaded with clear quartz veins, standing waist-deep in a mirror-still tidal flat at first light. Broad shoulders, level gaze, hands resting open at its sides; the low sun passes through the quartz and lays thin lines of light across the water. Palette: slate blue, pale gold, oyster white, soft teal. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.

A towering, long-limbed quadruped of polished copper and frosted glass, standing patiently on a high basalt ridge above a sea of morning cloud. Its noble head is lowered in thought, a steady amber glow banked inside its glass chest like a lantern. Cool dawn light rims its spine and long neck. Palette: burnished copper, warm amber, mist lavender, deep indigo. 1970s science-fiction paperback cover painting, landscape format, smooth airbrushed gradients, crisp highlights, a little film grain.
